audit.description: The changed production file app/services/cf_request_handler.py replaces import requests with import httpx and changes all three requests.get calls to httpx.get. Static evidence reports imports_target=true and imports_source=false for that production file, while dynamic evidence records 24 target events from production repo code with httpx resolving from site-packages and zero source import attempts or source imports from repo code. No local httpx provider or shim is indicated; target_local_spec_count is 0 and the target origin is the installed httpx package.
evidence: app/services/cf_request_handler.py: requests.get(url) -> httpx.get(url) in three production request methods
Static anti-cheat file check for app/services/cf_request_handler.py: imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Pipfile, requirements.txt, setup.cfg, cf_stats.egg-info files replace requests dependency entries with httpx
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully imports and calls httpx.get.
No changed production code evidence shows direct or dynamic requests usage.
Dynamic audit saw httpx imported from site-packages, not a local fake provider.
Dependency files replace requests with httpx.
